beats.sub: ご迷惑をおかけします
beats.caption: POV: day one in Tokyo and you can't read a *single* sign 😭

beats.text: この先工事中につき通行止め
beats.translation: Road closed ahead due to construction.
beats.explain: “Road closed ahead due to construction.” 通行止め is 通行 (traffic) + 止め (a stop): the road is shut. 〜につき is the formal “due to” of signs and notices.
beats.caption: …and *Tsuji* takes it apart, word by word
